description: Settings common to every NxtSend module: base URL, shared auth header, error mapping. Inherited by all modules.

errors.401: The NxtSend access token is invalid or expired. Reconnect the NxtSend connection in Make.
errors.403: This connection does not have the required scope (make.read for reads, make.write for changes). Reconnect with both scopes.
errors.404: The lead, campaign or conversation was not found in this workspace.
errors.422: The request was rejected (e.g. LinkedIn replies are not supported — inbox replies are email-channel only).
errors.429: Rate limit exceeded: 120 requests/minute per token. Make will retry on the next run.
errors.503: The NxtSend integration is disabled on this deployment, or the deployment is in Demo Mode (the API refuses demo outright).

label: NxtSend Base
notes: Replace <your-domain> with the deployment origin (e.g. https://nxtsend.com).
Secrets are sanitized from logs: the Authorization header value is never logged by Make.
